_about: D1a: one fighter's wound numbers (spec-wounds.md sections 1 and 2), loaded by sim/core/fighter_data.gd into a WoundsDef (f.wd). Wear is fixed-point: 6000 units per wear point. Units and ticks are integers. The rules stay code (sim/core/wounds.gd); this file only holds their numbers. Values marked pinned are also read as SimWounds constants by another owner's file, so the loader requires them to equal the constant until that reader moves to f.wd.
_regions: pitch A, the crippling moment (pitches.md section 5, balance-targets.md section 13): the brink is the core broken; limbs (spill) wear to battered and stop, and wear past battered spills into the core. A limb breaks only in a crippling moment (cripple)
_wearPerDamage: 350 (QA's combined list on 9da6e07, docs/qa/baseline-9da6e07.md: median length 492 to 469 s, first brink 417 to 387 s). It was 336, k 0.056 x 6000 (QA's +8% on the first agency build, docs/qa/baseline-agency1.md, accepted in agency-pass.md section 13), and 312 before that (QA's Q10 re-tune, docs/qa/retune-q10.md)
_act1Damping: wear x this while the act index is 1 (SimMood.act). Below 1 it slows act 1's wear; above 1 it speeds it, so the first wound beats and act 2 come sooner (QA's M1b tuning: 1.3 with k 0.036, docs/qa/tuning-m1b.md)

overtime._note: k x min(cap, 1 + perMin x minutes past start). Candidate A (default): 28800 ticks (8:00), 0.25. Candidate B: 30600 ticks (8:30), 0.40. QA picks by editing both fighters' files

fade._note: per tick: out 0.25/s below 60 out of exchanges; breath 1/s for battered regions after 240 ticks without an exchange, down to hiddenFloor (59; pinned: sim/director/ai.gd); hidden 3/s with the hiding kit

family._note: region pick weights (head, core, arms, legs) by hit family

guardWearSplit._note: a guard hit's wear: this share to the arms, this to the legs (Game Design: spread so legs can become battered)

penalties._note: S3a and S3b stage penalties; pitch A's post-break modifiers: a broken arm deals lights x1.15 (heavies and signatures x0.8), broken legs scale the DEFENSIVE multiplier by 0.8 (a stronger guard; the dash is gone). headParryNarrow (sim/director/melee.gd), headDefence and legsSlip (sim/director/data.gd) are pinned

lastStand._note: the last stand (spec-wounds section 1b, point 7): the first time this fighter reaches the brink in a match, one signature is free and off cooldown for windowS seconds, counted while he is free. 0 switches it off

cripple._note: a heavy-class blow (a heavy, a signature, a guard break or a chain strike) that lands on a battered limb in a decisive exchange breaks it on a keyed roll: base, + tierAhead if the attacker is a tier ahead, + lateBonus from act lateAct, + defensive (negative) if the victim holds DEFENSIVE. At most maxPerFighter limbs a match; the breaker's power rises by surgePower. The pick: among the victim's eligible limbs (cripple regions, battered at the exchange's start and still battered), the legs weigh legWeight against the arms' 1

rally._note: a mended region returns battered at 89; 15 s between Rallies
